parameters.query: SELECT (r.tool_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, r.definition->'evidence'->'required_types'->>0 AS evidence_type, r.readback_supported, r.accepted_methods, r.evidence_limitation FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.tool_registry r ON r.tool_id = $1 AND r.version = $2

SELECT (r.tool_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, r.definition->'evidence'->'required_types'->>0 AS evidence_type, r.readback_supported, r.accepted_methods, r.evidence_limitation FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.tool_registry r ON r.tool_id = $1 AND r.version = $2

INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.evidence (evidence_id, action_id, evidence_type, verification_method, verification_result, contract_tool_id, contract_version, readback_supported, observed_at, body)
SELECT r.evidence_id, r.action_id, r.evidence_type, r.verification_method, r.verification_result, r.contract_tool_id, r.contract_version, r.readback_supported, r.observed_at, r.body
FROM jsonb_to_record(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb)
AS r(evidence_id text, action_id text, evidence_type text, verification_method text, verification_result text, contract_tool_id text, contract_version text, readback_supported boolean, observed_at timestamptz, body jsonb)
RETURNING evidence_id
